mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months signals the start of a monetary easing cycle, lowering discount rates and increasing present value of future equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of 3-month easing periods, or 20-day returns fail to outperform a 5-day rolling average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction, reducing equity risk appetite and compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 80% of FEDFUNDS > 5.25% events, or 60-day returns fail to underperform a 5-day rolling average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 150,000 over 3 months signals weak labor demand, lowering equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of PAYEMS > 150000 events, or 20-day returns fail to underperform a 5-day rolling average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) below 120,000 over 3 months signals strengthening labor demand, improving equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of PAYEMS < 120000 events, or 60-day returns fail to outperform a 5-day rolling average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 points over 3 months indicates softening supply-side conditions, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of INDPRO < 105 events, or 20-day returns fail to underperform a 5-day rolling average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 115 points over 3 months signals improving supply conditions, lifting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of INDPRO > 115 events, or 60-day returns fail to outperform a 5-day rolling average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in retail sales (HOUST) above 1,500 units over 3 months signals robust consumer demand, improving equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of HOUST > 1500 events, or 20-day returns fail to outperform a 5-day rolling average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (HOUST) below 1,200 units over 3 months signals weak demand, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of HOUST < 1200 events, or 60-day returns fail to underperform a 5-day rolling average (t-test p > 0.05).
